Transformers process sequences with self-attention, letting every token attend to every other token. Encoder-only models such as BERT use bidirectional attention and are pooled into a single vector, which makes them well suited to semantic search, clustering and retrieval-augmented generation. Sentence embeddings are usually compared with cosine similarity after L2 normalisation, so tiny numerical differences in the forward pass show up directly as a lower cosine against the reference.
